items.source: Set the PersistenceManagedTypes to use to build the list of managed types as an alternative to entity scanning.
items.translation: 将 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 设置为构建托管类型列表的替代方案，以代替实体扫描。

items.source: Scan the specified packages and return a PersistenceManagedTypes that represents the result of the scanning.
items.translation: 扫描指定的包并返回一个代表扫描结果的PersistenceManagedTypes。

items.source: Apply the given PersistenceManagedTypes to this persistence unit, typically coming from Spring AOT.
items.translation: 将此PersistenceManagedTypes应用于此持久化单元，通常来自 Spring AOT。

items.source: Set the PersistenceManagedTypes to use to build the list of managed types for the default persistence unit, as an alternative to entity scanning.
items.translation: 将 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 设置为构建默认持久化单元托管类型列表的方式，作为实体扫描的替代方案。

items.source: Uses of PersistenceManagedTypes in org.springframework.orm.jpa
items.translation: `org.springframework.orm.jpa` 中 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 的用法

items.source: Uses of PersistenceManagedTypes in org.springframework.orm.jpa.persistenceunit
items.translation: `org.springframework.orm.jpa.persistenceunit` 包中 `PersistenceManagedTypes` 的用法

items.source: Package providing integration of JPA (Java Persistence API) with Spring concepts.
items.translation: 提供将 JPA（Java 持久化 API）与 Spring 概念集成的包。

items.source: Internal support for managing JPA persistence units.
items.translation: 用于管理 JPA 持久化单元的内部支持。

items.source: Create an instance using the specified managed class names.
items.translation: 使用指定的托管类名创建实例。

items.source: Create an instance using the specified managed class names and packages.
items.translation: 使用指定的托管类名和包创建实例。
